datasets.name: tickets
queryLines:
SELECT business_date, store_id, check_number, channel, financial_profile,
 customer_total, merchandise_after_discount, reported_discount, reported_tax,
 CASE WHEN reported_discount > 0 THEN 'Ticket discount present' ELSE 'No ticket discount' END discount_cohort
 FROM workspace.astro_taco_main_real.silver_checks WHERE is_demo = false

datasets.name: reviews
queryLines: review_reason, reconciliation_residual FROM workspace.astro_taco_main_real.silver_checks_review WHERE is_demo = false

datasets.name: snapshot
queryLines:
SELECT _astro_source source_table, _astro_source_version delta_version,
 min(_astro_loaded_at) loaded_at, count(*) source_rows
 FROM workspace.astro_taco_main_real.bronze_pos WHERE _astro_demo = false
 GROUP BY _astro_source, _astro_source_version

datasets.name: decisions
queryLines:
WITH c AS (
 SELECT count(*) published_checks, count(DISTINCT business_date) observed_days,
 count(DISTINCT store_id) observed_stores,
 sum(CASE WHEN reported_discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) discounted_checks
 FROM workspace.astro_taco_main_real.silver_checks WHERE is_demo = false),
 r AS (SELECT count(*) review_checks FROM workspace.astro_taco_main_real.silver_checks_review WHERE is_demo = false)
 SELECT 'Investigate' action, 'Financial exceptions' topic,
 concat(CAST(review_checks AS STRING), ' checks withheld; ', CAST(published_checks AS STRING), ' published') evidence,
 'Descriptive / reconciled' confidence,
 'Review exception reasons and source records before expanding financial reporting.' next_step,
 'No estimate of withheld sales' limitation FROM c CROSS JOIN r
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Design a test', 'Discount effectiveness',
 concat(CAST(discounted_checks AS STRING), ' published checks with positive ticket discount'),
 'Descriptive; selection bias remains',
 'Identify an offer and compare equivalent stores, baskets and time windows; plan a controlled test.',
 'Discount cohort differences are not causal promotion lift' FROM c
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Prepare history', 'Lift and seasonality',
 concat(CAST(observed_days AS STRING), ' observed days across ', CAST(observed_stores AS STRING), ' stores'),
 'Insufficient evidence',
 'Normalize historical source by store and period; verify missing days and a comparable baseline.',
 'Two holiday dates do not establish seasonal demand' FROM c
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Investigate', 'Menu mix and substitution',
 'Published item and category units are available', 'Descriptive only',
 'Confirm offer fingerprints, substitute sets and bundle components before comparing category change.',
 'Product revenue, causal cannibalization and margin are unavailable' FROM c
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Defer keep / stop / return', 'Promotion portfolio',
 'No confirmed campaign IDs, schedule or costs', 'Insufficient evidence',
 'Validate offer identity and baseline before issuing portfolio recommendations.',
 'No ROI, profit, retention or causal claims' FROM c

lines:
# 1. Business overview

Validated real POS extract: **2025-12-31 and 2026-01-01**. Amounts are in source monetary units; currency is unconfirmed. Customer amount includes tax; merchandise amount excludes tax after ticket discount. These are reconciled POS amounts, not audited revenue. Use Ask Genie for questions; use Genie Code in Edit mode to refine the dashboard.

# 2. Pricing and discounts

Compare ticket discount cohorts descriptively. A difference in basket value is **not promotion lift**. Ticket discount depth = sum(ticket discount) / sum(merchandise after discount + ticket discount). This is a ticket-level source field, not a product allocation or validated campaign redemption.

fields.name: value
fields.expression: AVG(CASE WHEN reported_discount > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)

frame.title: Share of tickets with a positive ticket discount
Reported ticket discounts — once per check

lines: **Price analysis gate:** unit-price normalization and comparable SKU identity must be validated before adding price distributions. Do not interpret bundle components, zero-price components, or Item Promo adjustments as standalone full-price products.

# 3. Demand and comparison readiness

Observed demand by POS-reported hour and channel. Dates straddle New Year; changes are descriptive. **Seasonality, expected demand, promotion lift and confidence intervals are unavailable until historical normalization and baseline validation.**

# 4. Menu mix and substitution signals

Units from reconciled, published checks only. Reported item/component units can include bundle components; summing them is not a count of unique standalone products. Voided items and promo monetary adjustments contribute zero units. **No allocated product revenue or proven cannibalization.**

frame.title: Item and component detail — explore categories first

lines:
# 5. Decisions and next experiments

Datathon question: **Which promotions should live, die, or come back?** This board separates actions supported today from decisions needing more evidence. **Whole validated snapshot: date/store filters do not change this board.** No invented promotion names or keep/stop/return rankings.

**Release gate for promotion recommendations:** reliable offer identity; adequate observed sample; comparable stores and periods; validated baseline; target and substitute-category outcomes; sensitivity and uncertainty. When these fail, recommend an investigation or controlled test. Costs are required for margin/ROI.

# 6. Trust and pipeline evidence

Source snapshot → Bronze → typed/classified Silver → reconciled tickets → Gold → validation. Financial profiles differ by store and are valid only for the mapped dates. Legitimate repeated item occurrences remain; financial exceptions are withheld. Row quarantine and ticket financial review are separate measures.

fields.name: published_checks
fields.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN is_publishable THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

frame.title: Structural row quality — whole snapshot, unfiltered

lines: [Successful real pipeline run](https://dbc-cfb7f93a-b497.cloud.databricks.com/jobs/621214800098362/runs/435278296555206?o=7474644614542766) | [Source and definitions](https://github.com/Roger079/databricks-astro-pipeline/blob/main/docs/data_contract.md). Profile A: customer amount = source Total; merchandise = Total − Tax. Profile B: customer amount = Total − ticket discount + Tax; merchandise = Total − ticket discount. Unknown store/date rules are withheld. The raw Total field mixes these meanings.
